property_summary: For any Owner-invoked Command with any calldata and ETH, the contract's balance after Command equals its balance before plus msg.value (Command does not transfer away existing balance); the mutant violates this by transferring the contract's pre-existing balance to Owner before executing the call, so post-call balance can be less than pre+msg.value for some inputs.
change_summary: Add a transfer of the contract balance to Owner before executing the call, altering balances observable after Command.
